senses.gloss: m. (a contraction of centurio, κεντυρίων, v. קוּנְטְרִינִים) commander of a century.
units: Sifré Deut. 309 אם היה ק׳ שגדול וכ׳ if it were a centurio who is more powerful than he (the buleutes) &c.; Yalk. ib. 942 קרטון (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:7">Tosef. Sot. XV, 7</cite> (two versions confounded, one having <he>בעל זמורה</he>, and the other <cite ref="S02049"><he>קי׳</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="G00511"><he>זְמוֹרָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 321">Yalk. Jer. 321</cite> <cite ref="S01994"><he>קרטון</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:3">Tosef. Dem. VI, 3</cite> <he>שוקל לאוצר שוקל לק׳ וכ׳</he> he that pays taxes to the (Roman) treasurer or to the Centurio, gives first the tithes and pays his taxes (on the remainder).
